name: Ring
description: A ring modulator tuned to a note of the key, with a slow drift: every partial is split into a sum and a difference, which turns plain tones into bells and gongs.

params.name: Root
params.description: The note the carrier is tuned to. Set it to the key of the piece.

params.name: Octave
params.description: Which octave of the root the carrier sits in. Low octaves flutter and growl, the middle ones thicken, the high ones ring like small bells.

params.name: Fine
params.description: Moves the carrier a little off its pitch. A touch against a played note gives slow beating; more gives a bent, sour bell.

params.name: Tune
params.description: Note tunes the carrier with Root and Octave. Free takes it from Frequency instead, from a slow pulse up to a whistle.

params.name: Frequency
params.description: The carrier when Tune is Free. Slow settings pulse the level like a tremolo; faster ones split every partial in two.

params.name: Wave
params.description: The shape of the carrier. Sine gives each partial one pair of new ones. Triangle and Soft square add fainter pairs higher up. Diode is rougher and leans on loud notes.

params.name: Second
params.description: Adds a second carrier above or below the first, so every partial throws two pairs of new ones and the bell gets an interval of its own.

params.name: Drift
params.description: A slow, free wander of the carrier around its pitch. A little makes held notes shimmer; a lot bends them out of tune and back.

params.name: Low Cut
params.description: Takes the lows out of the ringing sound, where the difference tones rumble. The dry sound is not touched.

params.name: Tone
params.description: Takes the highs out of the ringing sound, where the sum tones can turn harsh. The dry sound is not touched.

params.name: Width
params.description: Turns the carrier of the right side out of step with the left. The ringing spreads wide, and a slow carrier moves from side to side.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the dry sound and the ringing one. All the way up only the new partials are left and the played notes are gone.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. A four-quadrant multiplier with a band-limited carrier tuned by note, and a four-diode bridge as one of its carrier shapes; not a model of any one unit.
